company.name: Go Oats
company.one_liner: Bite-sized baked oatmeal balls for a healthy breakfast on the go.

facts.summary: A founder sells baked oatmeal bites with fruit fillings, aimed at busy people who skip breakfast.
highlights: It's a healthier grab-and-go breakfast snack.
Products are starting to appear in grocery stores.
Sales are still small; the business is early.
Healthy snacks is a crowded space with lots of brands.

real_deal.summary: Barbara Corcoran agreed to $150,000 for 20% on the show, but the deal never closed.

outcome.headline: Still a small business: in some big stores, with about $2M a year in sales.
outcome.story: Go Oats got into stores like Costco and Whole Foods in some regions and kept growing slowly. It's private and small, so the value here (~$2M) is an estimate based on reported sales.
